verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser offers isolated environments: cloud sandboxes with fast startup and command execution, and browser sessions documented as isolated instances. These give an agent somewhere to run experiments away from your own systems, but nothing shows a dedicated test or staging mode for the Hyperbrowser service itself. Missing for 10: a documented test/sandbox mode or test API keys separate from production usage, guidance on keeping test data separate from production data or credits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
